prompt: A wraid (Wraid), a Star Wars canon creature. Wraids were large reptilian creatures found on many desert planets across the galaxy (including but not limited to Tatooine, Ruhnuk, Korriban and even Tython). They were carnivorous creatures, relying on scavening and ambush to find their prey. Wraids were often over hunted for their valuable hides, causing their populations to spike and fall. RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
style_notes: RimWorld creature sprite, Star Wars desert bestiary, our own art (not the donor mod's).
